description: Populate 01_Architecture folder with comprehensive system architecture documents, update root README to ADVIS branding, and create 05_Interface_Control_Documents content. This covers system block diagrams, power tree, ground domains, signal flow, thermal strategy, mechanical envelope, SoC variants, and all ICDs.
steps: Update /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/README.md: Replace all IND-VIAS references with ADVIS (Adaptive Driver & Vehicle Intelligence System). Add product family table (Assist, Control, Fusion, Fleet). Update project description to match ADVIS branding.
Update /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/README.md: Replace IND-VIAS with ADVIS throughout.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/System_Block_Diagrams/ADVIS_System_Block_Diagram.md: Complete system block diagram in ASCII art showing all subsystems (Power Entry -> Protection -> Buck stages -> SOM, DS90UB954 -> CSI-2 -> SOM, CAN PHY, GNSS, IMU, USB, IR, Watchdog). Include signal names, bus widths, connector references.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Power_Tree/Power_Tree_Architecture.md: Full power tree from 12V input through all stages: 12V -> Fuse(5A) -> TVS -> PMOS(80V) -> LM61460-Q1(5V_SYS,6A) -> TPS62130A-Q1(3.3V) -> TLV75518-Q1(1.8V). Include ASCII diagram, current budgets per rail, sequencing requirements, power good signals.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Ground_Domains/Ground_Domain_Architecture.md: Define PGND_IN (power input ground), BOARD_GND (signal ground), CHASSIS_GND (enclosure/shield). Document star-point topology, ground domain interconnection rules, ESD return paths.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Signal_Flow/Signal_Flow_Architecture.md: Document all signal paths between subsystems: FPD-Link III (camera to deser), CSI-2 (deser to SOM 4-lane MIPI), SPI (SOM to BMI088 dual-CS), I2C (SOM to DS90UB954 config), UART (SOM to NEO-M9N), CAN-FD (SOM to TCAN1044AV-Q1), USB (SOM to USB-C). Include data rates, impedance targets, protocol details.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Thermal_Strategy/Thermal_Strategy.md: Thermal budget allocation per component, heat dissipation paths, passive vs active cooling analysis for each tier, thermal interface materials, operating temperature range (-40C to +85C ambient), derating curves.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Mechanical_Envelope/Mechanical_Envelope.md: Target form factor for windshield-mount module, enclosure dimensions (estimated), mounting strategy, IP rating target, connector access zones, weight budget, vibration tolerance.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/SoC_Variants/SoC_Variant_Matrix.md: Compatibility matrix for AM62A, AM68A/TDA4VM, TDA4VH, SA8295. Include: camera inputs, AI performance (TOPS), power budget, memory, CSI-2 lanes, supported tier, carrier compatibility notes.
Update /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/01_Architecture/Modular_Platform_Definition/Platform_Modularity_Concept.md: Replace all IND-VIAS with ADVIS.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/05_Interface_Control_Documents/SoM_Carrier_ICD/SoM_Carrier_Interface_Specification.md: Define the logical interface between SoM and carrier. List all signals by function group (power rails, CSI-2, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, GPIO, reset, clocks). Define electrical requirements, sequencing, direction. Note: exact pinout is TRADE SECRET - do not include physical pin numbers.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/05_Interface_Control_Documents/Camera_ICD/Camera_Interface_Specification.md: FPD-Link III interface spec for both forward and DMS cameras. Include: cable type (coax), PoC voltage, data rate, virtual channel assignment (VC0=Forward, VC1=DMS), connector type, cable length limits, shielding requirements.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/05_Interface_Control_Documents/Vehicle_Connector_ICD/Vehicle_Connector_Interface_Specification.md: J100 vehicle harness interface. Define: 12V power pins, ground returns, CAN_H/CAN_L, ignition sense, wake input, GNSS antenna feed-through, shield/chassis ground. Include mating/unmating requirements.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/05_Interface_Control_Documents/IR_Daughterboard_ICD/IR_Daughterboard_Interface_Specification.md: J800 8-pin IR illumination board interface. Define: power supply (voltage, current limit), IR_LED_EN, IR_PWM, FAULT_N, ground, shield. Include enable/disable logic, PWM frequency range, thermal protection.

Create /projects/sandbox/ADVIS_Hwpackage/05_Interface_Control_Documents/Pin_Mux_Maps/Pin_Mux_Strategy.md: Document pin multiplexing approach per SoC variant. Define which SoC peripherals map to which carrier functions. Note: exact pin assignments are TRADE SECRET - document the strategy and allocation method only.
acceptance_criteria: All files listed in steps exist with substantive content (minimum 50 lines each for architecture docs)
All IND-VIAS references in updated files are changed to ADVIS
ASCII block diagrams are present in System_Block_Diagrams and Power_Tree documents
No trade secrets (exact pinout, PCB layout rules, calibration thresholds) appear in any document
Safety boundary (observation/processing/logging only, no actuation) is clearly stated where applicable
verification: Check all created files exist and have content over 50 lines
Grep for 'IND-VIAS' in modified files to confirm none remain
Grep for 'trade secret' markers to confirm sensitive info is properly protected
findings: All 16 files created/updated successfully. Line counts range from 103 to 234 lines for architecture docs. No IND-VIAS references remain in the modified files. Remaining IND-VIAS references exist in folders 02, 04, 06, 07, 11, 13 which are out of scope for this feature. No trade secrets (exact pinouts, PCB layout rules, calibration thresholds) leaked into any document.
